{'': 'Apple Rolls Out macOS 27 Developer Beta 6'}

{'': 'With the final stretch before the official release drawing near, Apple is now pushing out the macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 6 to all developers.'}

{'': "The fifth beta released last week brought refreshed icons for several apps including Siri, Chess, and Safari, but didn't add any other major features (nor any noticeable bugs)."}

{'': 'macOS 27 Golden Gate introduces a dedicated Siri app, unifies the corner radius across windows and apps, and adds AI-powered features to Shortcuts and Safari, letting users create extensions and automations with simple prompts.'}

{'': 'The new system also brings a pull-to-refresh gesture to Safari, which many see as an early signal that Apple is laying the groundwork for the rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro, aiming to make macOS more touch-friendly.'}

{'': 'macOS 27 Golden Gate also redesigns the iPhone Mirroring app, letting users resize windows to different aspect ratios — a change also seen as a precursor to the rumored foldable iPhone Ultra launching next month.'}

{'': 'The official version of macOS 27 Golden Gate carries the build number 26A5416b.'}

{'': 'How to Install the macOS 27 Golden Gate Beta'}

{'': "Here's how to install macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 5:"}

  • {'': 'Back up your Mac'}
  • {'': 'Open System Settings'}
  • {'': 'Go to General → Software Update'}
  • {'': 'Click the "i" icon next to "Beta Updates"'}
  • {'': 'From the drop-down in the top right, select "macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta"'}
  • {'': 'Click Done'}

{'': 'Have you spotted any new features in this latest macOS 27 Golden Gate beta? Drop them in the comments.'}
